description: Enum class representing different statuses of grouping types within the Fineract project, including status codes, labels, and utility methods for status checks.

classes.name: GroupingTypeStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of grouping status states with associated codes and utility methods.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer status value to its corresponding GroupingTypeStatus enum.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current status matches a given status.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the status.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Checks if the status is pending.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the status is active.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the status is closed.

methods.name: isTransferInProgress
methods.description: Checks if a transfer is in progress.

methods.name: isTransferOnHold
methods.description: Checks if a transfer is on hold.

methods.name: isUnderTransfer
methods.description: Checks if the status indicates an ongoing transfer or hold.
